claims.statement: URE reported that Poland's first monitored year of cable pooling produced 49 shared-connection agreements, 62 issued connection conditions across 130 applications, and 47 refusals.
URE says cable pooling can improve use of existing infrastructure but identifies connection-capacity exceedance and limitations involving support for subsequent installations as material challenges.
Hypothesis: some incumbent generators will grant assignable co-development options and developers will pay for screened rights; neither side of that market is yet validated.

contrary_evidence: In 2024, 47 of 130 cable-pooling applications reported by URE were refused, and broader Polish RES connection refusals remained substantial.
URE attributes limited use of some cable-pooling variants partly to support-scheme restrictions for second and subsequent installations.

economics.acquisition_route: Screen ten referred operating sites, offer at most two low-cost conditional options, and seek one developer diligence payment before committing more capital.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated path: a mature studio closing five projects yearly at PLN 450,000 average net fee can generate about PLN 2.25m revenue and PLN 0.9m operating profit; a 4x operating-profit value gives PLN 3.6m enterprise value, while separately retained and externally valued SPV carries would need to add more than PLN 2m for a 75% founder stake plus personal cash to exceed PLN 5m. A 7-10 year path is plausible only after repeated closes; no grid or project value is assumed at discovery.
economics.founder_time: 12-20 hours per week with a strict two-option cap while employed; specialists handle legal, grid and engineering diligence, and a project manager is required before scaling.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated estimate: 50-70% after grid, legal, land and engineering specialists; failed options and long cycle times are the central margin drag.
economics.payback: Unvalidated target: 18-30 months from one paid assignment or financial close; total loss of option and diligence spend is possible.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: PLN 10,000-25,000 screening retainer credited against PLN 250,000-750,000 assignment or close fee, or a 3-8% carried project interest; no fee or carry is assumed before a signed milestone.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Generators can bring additional sites and developers can repeatedly buy standardized data rooms, but each project remains lumpy rather than subscription revenue.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a reputation for clean, assignable options plus a proprietary map of complementary profiles creates preferred access to owners before broadly marketed developers arrive
fingerprint.customer: renewable generators with underused connection profiles and specialist developers or infrastructure investors seeking screened Polish projects
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: use installer and regional owner referrals, public installation information and specialist developer relationships; begin with one technology pairing and two sites
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: resource-profile screen, contractual option, data-room preparation, land and support review, and developer auction sold as project origination rather than construction
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the site owner may pay a small screening retainer; the developer pays an assignment or success fee at an agreed diligence milestone or financial close, with optional carried SPV interest
fingerprint.problem_trigger: an existing site has unused connection capacity or a complementary generation profile, while the owner lacks time or capital to originate the second project

founder_fit: Leverages the family's renewable-sector access and the founder's modeling skills.
Keeps construction capex with developers and investors rather than the founder.
A small option portfolio can be screened alongside employment if concurrency is tightly limited.
Success depends on analytical diligence and contract quality more than public personal branding.
risks: Grid-connection refusal or delay can eliminate option value after sunk diligence.
Support-scheme restrictions may make a technically possible shared connection uneconomic.
Options may be non-assignable, inadequately documented or challenged by lenders and counterparties.
Project development is relationship-heavy and can exceed the founder's available time.

structure.control_point: assignable, time-bounded co-development options with incumbent generators covering site access, data-room access and negotiation of a shared connection
structure.critical_dependency: a complementary project must pass site, support-scheme and grid review and the incumbent's agreements must permit a lawful shared-connection structure

thesis: Originate time-limited co-development options with owners of operating or permitted renewable sites whose grid connection could support a complementary solar or wind installation under Poland's cable-pooling rules. Fund desktop screening, land and connection diligence, then assign the validated option to a specialist developer or retain a small carried interest at financial close. The startup controls a contractually exclusive development window, not the grid connection itself; every option remains conditional on owner consent, support-scheme compatibility and DSO approval.
title: Cable-Pooling Co-Development Option Portfolio
uncertainties: Which operating-site profiles have genuinely spare connection capacity rather than nominal headroom?
What option consideration will owners require, and will they grant exclusivity before a grid study?
Which developers will pay for early-stage Polish cable-pooling rights?
Can a small option be structured without accidentally assuming regulated energy or development obligations?
